description: Election Commission - Declare S. Wijekumar as a member of the Kundasale Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Kundasale Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral procedures, political party nominations, and the declaration of a selected member to fill a vacant seat. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral processes and related matters at the local government level.
